quarterly_data.signal: Supplier Tempus AI (data license to Recursion): Recursion's 10-Q: in November 2023 Recursion entered into a five-year agreement (the Tempus Agreement) with Tempus AI to purchase access to its records of patient-centric multimodal oncology data and use rights for therapeutic development; the data is used to improve the training of Recursion's artificial intelligence and machine learning models. Recursion makes annual payments ranging between $22.0 million and $42.0 million, up to $160.0 million in aggregate, in cash or equity at its option.
